en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of this course is to acquaint students with methods of protected vegetable cultivation in controlled conditions, with focus on mechanisation and automation of the production process.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Climate in vegetable production (allowance 1/3)2.Computer technologies in production systems (allowance 1/3)3.Automation in irrigation and fertilisation (allowance 1/3)4.Nutritional status evaluation (allowance 2/6)5.Nutritional value of vegetable - evaluation (allowance 2/6)6.Vegetable pathogens (allowance 1/3)7.Bioagens in vegetable production (allowance 1/3)8.Extension service, advisory in production (allowance 1/3)
